feature: Sidekick Errand Planner: actual model-first, bounded multi-item comparison, clarifying questions and follow-up revisions with fresh canonical facts and explicit review/cart action.

boundaries.correctionTrigger: Only schema-valid proposals rejected by canonical validation. No automatic retry for HTTP/provider/auth/transport failure.
boundaries.writeAuthority: The model has no application write tools. Only a separate user review/save calls existing scoped cart upserts; preparation, payment and fulfillment remain explicit.

initialConnectedAttempt.cause: Three test-contract mismatches across four viewports: new modelAttempts=0 field, compact history item-pair encoding, and a global main selector matching Next loading plus page content.
initialConnectedAttempt.correction: Exact contract assertions updated; retained quantity/ID/partial-save/expiry checks and scoped real page content. All16 passed on rerun.

localVerification.counting: Focused local cases overlap final CI; they are not added to its distinct browser total.

hostedVerification.viewportProvenance: One fresh private Customer browser at1280px then resized360px; times in these screenshots are UTC.

limits: A successful structured model response can still require user clarification; it does not promise an optimal or exhaustive recommendation.
Numbers, stock, allowed IDs and pickup eligibility are re-read and validated after model latency. Displayed snapshots need fresh server approval before preparation.
Stored private addresses/account data are not attached to the provider payload; the user-entered request and bounded conversation are submitted.
Cart saving is sequential, may partially succeed and sets selected quantities; other cart items are excluded from planner subtotal.
No new PayPal capture, signed webhook delivery, real payout or commercial launch is asserted by this AI release. Existing Sandbox payment evidence remains separate.
Existing optional Resend delivery-feedback configuration is unchanged and remains a separate operational follow-up.
